act_title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

quests.title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

dialogue.t: ({NICKNAME} scheduled a day off for me today. He(She) probably wants me to relax.)
(I don't think there's time to spare for that... I'd rather just keep pushing...)
(But I promised Vodyanitsa and {NICKNAME} I'd stick to the schedule... so I should keep my word.)
A glass of lemonade and a serving of Snowball Blooms Atop Snowfields, please. Thank you.
(I suppose... a little rest never hurt anyone.)
